title: The Vikings

cards.h: The monks of Lindisfarne had a very bad Monday
cards.b:
On 8 June 793, raiders in dragon-prowed ships landed at the monastery of Lindisfarne off England's coast. They killed monks and took treasure. The English scholar Alcuin wrote in shock that nothing like it had been seen.

This is where the Viking Age begins, a 250-year burst of raids, trade and settlement from Scandinavia.

Their longships were light and shallow, and could cross open sea and sail up rivers. They had a sail and oars. A raiding party could appear from nowhere and leave quickly.

'Viking' meant to go raiding. Most Scandinavians were farmers, traders and craftspeople.

In the east, Swedish Vikings called the Rus travelled down rivers. Tradition says Rurik founded Novgorod around 862. They gave Russia its name. The Byzantine emperors hired them as the Varangian Guard.

Settlers reached Iceland around 874. In 930 they set up the Althing, often called the world's oldest surviving parliament, where chiefs met to make laws.

From Iceland came the great sagas. Erik the Red was exiled and founded a colony in Greenland about 985.

His son Leif Erikson reached North America about 1000 CE. At L'Anse aux Meadows in Newfoundland, archaeologists found Norse buildings. A 2021 study of tree rings dated cut wood there to 1021 CE.

The colony did not last. They probably clashed with local peoples and were too far from home.

The Vikings settled in northern France, where they became the Normans. In 1066 two invasions hit England. King Harold beat the Norwegian king Harald Hardrada at Stamford Bridge, then lost to William of Normandy at Hastings.

By then, Scandinavian kings had become Christian. The Viking Age faded.

Myth: yes.Fact: no Viking helmet with horns has ever been found. The image comes from 19th-century costume art, especially for Wagner's operas (1876).

Also, Vikings were not only raiders. They traded, farmed and settled, and some women owned property. A burial at Birka in Sweden once thought a male warrior was shown by DNA to be a woman (2017), though what that means is debated.

Five things to remember

  1. The Viking Age started with Lindisfarne in 793.
  2. Longships let them raid and trade.
  3. Vikings reached Iceland, Greenland and North America.
  4. The Rus helped found early Russia.
  5. Horned helmets are a myth.

Think about it

  • Why did Scandinavians go overseas?
  • Who counts as a 'Viking'?
